author: Gmelin, 1789
summary: 온몸의 깃이 광택 있는 녹청색이고 얼굴이 밝은 붉은색을 띠는 새다. 바다에 면한 절벽에 둥지를 틀고 알 3~4개를 낳는다. 알래스카와 북동아시아에 분포한다.

points.en: bright red face around the eyes and at the bill base

art.subject: Red-faced Cormorant (Phalacrocorax urile), adult in breeding plumage (late winter to summer): plumage black with a strong iridescent sheen, green to violet on the head and neck and bronzy purple on the back and wings; two short shaggy crests, one on the forehead and one on the nape; a white patch on each flank. Extensive bright red bare skin covering the face around the eye and onto the forehead and the base of the bill; long pale yellowish bill; black legs and webbed feet.
art.pose: standing on a ledge of a sea cliff
art.scene: rocky sea cliff ledges above the open sea; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing on a ledge: glossy dark green-violet and bronze plumage, forehead and nape crests, white flank patch, bright red face, pale yellowish bill, black feet
adult, head detail: bare red skin covering the forehead, lores and the area around the eye, two crests, long pale bill
art.build: Large cormorant, 71–76cm, a little smaller and slimmer than the Great Cormorant and larger than the Pelagic Cormorant; long slender neck, small head and long body held upright when standing. Bill long and straight, hooked at the tip, thicker than the Pelagic Cormorant's. Legs short, black, set far back, with all four toes webbed. Tail fairly long and stiff. Flies with the neck outstretched and the long tail trailing.
avoid: Do not paint a thin dark bill and only a small red patch at the gape; those mark the Pelagic Cormorant (Phalacrocorax pelagicus).
Do not give it white cheeks, a yellow throat patch or a white throat (Great and Japanese Cormorants).
Do not show the red face as a hanging wattle; it is flat bare skin.
